scope: docs index exposure gates for existing-hub, low-density route surfaces, and GitHub Pages live verification; law-response onboarding coverage

gates.title: Existing hub entry router
guardrails: choose an existing hub or section checkpoint before creating any new hub
route low-density axes through section-low-density-hub-path-exposure-2026-05-07
do not promote this gate into graph/data, catalogs, README, or landing surfaces in this lane

gates.title: Low-density hub/path exposure checkpoint
guardrails: expose one grouped section link and one coverage link instead of five per-axis links
only use existing root markdown route, walkthrough, checklist, FAQ, and source notes
stop before graph/data, generated catalogs, README, landing, commit, or push work

gates.title: GitHub Pages live docs verification checkpoint
guardrails: verify the published GitHub Pages docs/index.html only after merge/deploy; do not assume local links prove live exposure
live check is read-only: confirm docs/index.html exposes gates.json, existing-hub router, low-density section, and coverage links
if Pages is stale or 404, record deploy/cache status instead of editing graph/data, catalogs, README, or landing files
compare live HTML labels against local docs/index.html and docs/gates.json targets; HTTP 200 alone is not sufficient evidence
live comparison guardrail: status 200 with stale/mismatched title must be recorded as WAIT/live-local mismatch, not PASS or completed exposure

lastLiveCheck.guardrail: Third WAIT evidence: HTTP 200 alone is not sufficient; expected route title is absent while the gateway title is present, so keep Pages reflection classified as WAIT-3, not PASS. Repeated WAIT-to-FAIL escalation belongs to the main/process owner.

gates.title: 민원대응 onboarding coverage
guardrails: newcomer onboarding must classify inquiry, complaint, grievance, and repeat complaint before drafting a response
evidence bundle must separate complaint text, attachments, public basis, jurisdiction/transfer candidate, and excluded personal or sensitive material
response/repeat complaint log checklist records receipt, response basis, masking, repeat/new-material decision, transfer/owner, and next action without exposing private details
public/private/personal-info boundary must be checked before sharing any response draft outside the processing lane
keep exposure limited to docs/index.html, docs/gates.json, and root section/coverage/quality/manifest markdown

gates.title: 정보공개기록관리 onboarding coverage
guardrails: newcomer onboarding must start from public/private boundary before drafting an answer
evidence bundle must separate public source, confirmed record, protected category, and owner question
response log checklist records request, basis, masking, decision, and next owner without exposing private details
keep exposure limited to docs/index.html, docs/gates.json, and root section/coverage/quality/manifest markdown

gates.title: 협업회의운영 onboarding coverage

agenda/minutes/follow-up checklist records purpose, stakeholders, confirmed facts, decisions, holds, owners, deadlines, and next check without exposing private details

draft/approval/distribution log checklist records request intake, draft, review/approval, distribution, press inquiry/correction, and next owner without exposing private details

gates.title: 법령대응 onboarding coverage
guardrails: newcomer onboarding must classify law lookup, authoritative interpretation, revision review, public notice/opinion handling, and internal legal review before drafting any reply

evidence bundle must separate current law text, public notice/revision draft, article comparison, authoritative/public interpretation source, owner confirmation, and excluded internal or unconfirmed material

public/private/unconfirmed-interpretation boundary must stop unpublished interpretation, non-public consultation, internal legal review, and case-specific application conclusions before external sharing

gates.title: Main merge diff risk review
guardrails: do not merge or publish to main from this lane
treat the branch diff as outside small docs-only exposure scope
review docs/index.html section preservation before any main merge because baseline HEAD b1887d5 has root markdown 1791, docs/index.html 190 lines, and Pages source main:/docs pending acceptance
keep this gate limited to docs/index.html, docs/gates.json, and root section/coverage/quality/manifest markdown exposure

gates.title: Main merge diff review packet exposure
guardrails: expose the review packet gate only; do not merge, commit, push, rebase, or publish from this lane
preserve existing docs/index.html sections; add links inside the docs/landing exposure section only
keep review status blocking until the main/process owner reviews the branch delta and docs/index section preservation
do not expand README, landing pages, catalogs, graph/data, or generated exports in this lane
